notes.title: 🎄Festive Notice to all Leaders - Rawcember has arrived!🎅
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/a9f295d3c9c88696aceffca6d51e2eb33c3cd329.gif[/img]
“Jingle, jingle…”🔔

Do you hear this lovely sound, Leaders? 

It’s the delicate chime of the winter bells - which indicates that today is the first day of December! But, as the old legend goes, no December is merely a month in our beautiful Kingdom…

Dear Leaders, prepare your hearts as we invite you for this grand commencing - an event of unparalleled magnificence that will fill the season with incredible joy fit for the cool kids!

And the name of that event is
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/cd705518746fcb620ad3b95b806e5d8aa9da622e.png[/img]
The gates swing wide open to reveal this figure-of-speech winter wonderland! All of Raw Fury games and the team behind them come together to celebrate each other and, as the Kingdom team, we would like to share some of our fireplace stories about personal experiences with creating Kingdom✨

The most fantastic part of this month-long event is that it’s only the beginning! Expect more news, collaborations, streams, giveaways and exciting activities, some of which coming up as soon as later today🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/ce5ea4da53e687c26d03ab5aa9447c07c115f511.png[/img]

[h2][b]Join us around a cozy fireplace - it’s story time with the devs✨[/b][/h2]

[i][h3]Immerse yourself in stories that transcend time, weaving a tapestry of magic and adventure. Let the written word be a lantern guiding you through the labyrinth of imagination.[/h3][/i]

[i]“Before all character sprites were done, we would put cats in the game as placeholders! My other favorite is the randomly rotating stuff... like when the mule just decides it walks on its face.”[/i] Alan, Game Designer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/2ca753d7db6a729973166899518aab478efe4b9f.png[/img]

[i]“My fav bug is the one where you can get a duplicate dog. Two dogs. That’s a “not-a-bug-it’s-a-feature” bug, if I ever saw one.”[/i] Angelica, Experience Producer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/016cca98585be0a4d7781938ca5c464a095013f0.jpg[/img]
[i]“Three winters ago, I joined the Kingdom team and one of the first things I got to do was play Kingdom Two Crowns in co-op together with Gordon Van Dyke. He taught me a Kingdom hack I never would have figured out on my own - if you upgrade your castle several levels fast, you get your first walls and wall upgrades for free! It was a privilege to learn from the best.”[/i] Elisabeth, Producer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/912d95198d530111339faa65fb0c425a541ea18e.png[/img]
“[i]I think my favorite bug has to be in Shogun when you chop down a tree a ninja was hiding behind, he wouldn't mind and just stood there hiding in plain sight😅But being so well-trained, he pulled it off, and the Greed would walk right past him anyway. 
P.S. I'm not even sure anymore, if we fixed this or not, I think we did.[/i]” Danijel, Developer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/22ddf9751bbd4a10aa955c18ffa439cebd23cc43.png[/img]
“[i]When I joined the Kingdom team as a QA I was told to just play the game for the first couple of weeks to learn it. This liberty allowed me to figure out one of the known, but unreproducible issues. That was my first ticket in Jira and remains one of my favorite bugs to this day.😊 It was this peasant who moved like they were waterskiing. I called it "a slider".

It was challenging to reproduce and it took me about a week of playtesting to figure it out. Eventually, I exposed it!

The issue would happen when a floater would pick up a peasant and then when archers would kill the floater, the peasant would drop and remain frozen in this animation, sliding their way until they would pick up a tool and become an employed citizen.😊[/i]"Kristina, QA Manager

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/659dc112249897ed3bb5c2271fff86e537c75640.png[/img]
[i]“Now with the Christmas season coming and the snow already laying on the streets, I can’t help but imagine what it would be like to just hang out with my colleagues in Christmas jumpers, have some hot chocolate and gingerbread cookies, then altogether gather in the Gaming Room, and just play the Two Crowns co-op with one another😊”[/i] Driver, Senior Community Manager

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/6fdbd9093cbd27802cabd29761bfa7e0fb24ff8f.png[/img]

[i]“My favourite thing is playing the Christmas Event in Kingdom New Lands. No matter how many times I play it, it still makes me so happy to get to prance around on a reindeer and drop presents. I absolutely love Christmas and this never fails to get me in the festive mood.

The thing I recently discovered is that, if presents drop near the Greed, they'll take those in place of a coin and it's actually so cute seeing a little Greed holding a present.”[/i] Vicki, Community Ambassador

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/4840bd3fb2ae0cd5c6a3c4524d3f68a2f6eca282.jpg[/img] 

[h3]Share your cozy Kingdom stories with us in the comments to this post!🤗[/h3]

And don’t forget to subscribe to our social channels as Rawcember is just starting to unveil its treasures🎁

[url=https://twitter.com/kingdomthegame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/kingdomthegame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/rawfury/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@rawfurygames]TikTok[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/CRvHk5jz]Discord[/url]

notes.content:
[h3]Survival Mixtapes already buzzing in your menu🕹️[/h3]
We hope you’ve got your walkmans ready, Campers, because the Survival Mixtapes are available now! Press play on the mixtape in the pause menu and get ready for the heart-pounding survival gameplay🔥Try your luck with beating endless waves of Greed to earn yourself a bronze, silver or gold crown - how many days will you last? You might even want to stay submerged in the captivating vintage synths longer and see, if there is an end to your survival - perhaps even an extra special reward?👀

Strategy and daringness, danger and excitement - has fighting monsters ever felt so real? One way to find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/c661b56b8a731cb0090ef432ea7059920684a52f.gif[/img]

[h3]Cool patch notes for the cool kids: Kingdom Eighties including Survival Mixtapes, version No - 1.1.0🌆[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Knights have received new training, with a buffed leap attack that will knock back the Greed from walls and the Siege Dumpster. The Knights also participate in the Siege now.
[*] The Greed can now destroy the Turrets but the Workers repair them every morning for free. This balance challenges the way you expand the base and makes you hone your survival tactics. 
[*] Turret damage and rate of fire have been rebalanced to adjust to the above change.
[*] The interactions between the Greed and the Siege Barrier, especially with larger Greed types, have been improved. These are bug fixes for improper behaviours, the Siege Barrier now should block the Greed more reliably.
[*] Performance improvements.
[*] Fixed situations when portals spawned too close to the campfire.
[*] The campaign difficulty setting "Cursed" has been rebalanced and will now provide an even tougher challenge!
[/list]

notes.title: Looks Like That Lost Mixtape Was Ours All Along📼
notes.content:
[h3]Bringing the ultimate challenge to Kingdom Eighties[/h3]
Survival Mixtapes is a brand-new Kingdom Eighties game mode that will give a complete overhaul to the way you play the game. Did you love the atmospheric, nostalgic locations from the base game but felt like you had too much time for camp ghost stories instead of fighting off the ravenous Greed, or that there simply wasn’t enough challenge? 

We heard you and hand-crafted this experience to let you explore the beautiful retro-neon levels inside-out but also prepare for much more ferocious Greed, gathering around your camp with armies larger than ever before - all to steal your Crown. What will you do to protect your friends, expand your camp, keep the glory of your ancestors - the Crown of Creation - and eventually destroy the Greed? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/c0fade607dcce18c45a2001041b25988cb7aa6db.gif[/img]

[h3]Main features[/h3]
🪙 Revisit the four locations from the main campaign – but with a challenging twist:

[list]

notes.title: Patch Updates 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hey campers! 
[/h3]

We’re so happy to see so many of you enjoying Kingdom Eighties. In today’s update, we’re bringing you a patch that will eliminate some of the most urgent bugs and issues that you’ve reported to us from your playthroughs. 

[b]General fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Your archers will now defend your entire Kingdom if there is a Blood Moon and a Retaliation Wave happening simultaneously, instead of stacking at the Blood Moon side only. 
[*] Your archers will no longer sometimes stop attacking while taking part in a Siege assault. 
[*] The Champ no longer gets stuck in a running animation when you pay to activate the Siege Dumpster just before exiting a cave.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from picking up their dropped crown after loading a save.
[*] Greed portals should no longer spawn so close to the camp that you are prevented from building your innermost wall. Let us know if the problem persists when you generate a new map!
[/list]

[b]Episode specific fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Champ’s trophy event in Episode I will now always trigger correctly when paid for.
[*] Exiting the cave in Episode I without your crown will now trigger game loss correctly, instead of causing a freeze.
[*] The Tinkerer can no longer get stuck in a walking animation by the cave in Episode III.
[*] The workers will no longer drop the canoe as soon as the Siege Dumpster is destroyed or abandoned in the cave in Episode I, which would sometimes leave the canoe out of reach.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the player to be stuck in the cave after fulfilling the victory conditions in Episode IV.
[*] You can now leave the cave in Episode IV at any time, allowing you to regroup and try again after a failed Siege assault.
[/list]

[b]Achievement fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] “County Connection” will now trigger correctly in all episodes.
[*] “Saw Boss” will now trigger correctly in Episode IV.
[*] “Loner” will now trigger correctly in Episode IV. 
[*] “George Burnett Had Twins” will now trigger correctly in Episode IV.
[/list]

[h3]We’ll have another update to Eighties ready for you after the dev team has returned from their summer holidays. Stay tuned![/h3]

notes.title: [Sneak Peek] Recruiting the kids in Kingdom Eighties
notes.content:
[h3]Development team checking in! Are you guys up for some sneak peeks?[/h3]

[b]In this week’s blog, we're getting familiarized with Kingdom Eighties' take on a classic Kingdom mechanic - your loyal subjects.  [/b]

As a ruler in Kingdom Two Crowns, you would grow your Kingdom by recruiting new citizens from encampments out in the woods. But in Kingdom Eighties, we’re shaking things up. This time around, your ruler is a teenage camp counselor that is joined by tiny, but brave, kids. So what kind of a town would Monarch be if there were homeless kids living in makeshift tents everywhere? Nah, we couldn't really have that. So we ended up choosing different buildings for each location. At summer camp, kids hang around outside their cabins, and in the suburbs, the playground is the place to be. Among the bustling shops of Main Street, you’ll find kids by the doorstep of the shoe shops - just waiting for adventure (that’s you!) to pick 'em up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/dff19a0ce3dd9ecb88e15effd6bf47d5f0e319cb.png[/img]

Here's where things got a bit tricky for the development team. With the recruitment buildings looking different in every location, how could we make sure that the player always knew where to find the kids? We needed a visual clue to help guide the players. 

The solution came when one of our designers remembered something he used to see as a kid. Shoes tied together by the laces and tossed over power lines. A symbol for both celebration and rebellion - these stinky, outgrown sneakers were exactly what we needed. So if you ever find yourself in need of more kids to join you in the battle against the Greed - now you know what to look for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/eb5c5eb6ec019ee5144b780cb2fd6147c9235d76.gif[/img]

[i]But there's more! Let's talk about putting those kids to work! Not in a “child labor” kinda way, more of a "let's get shit done because the greed is invading our neighborhood" kinda way.[/i]

A new feature in Kingdom Eighties is that the kids will not only do things like build walls, shoot arrows or chop down trees. They are also eager to earn pocket money by doing chores around the Kingdom, such as mowing the lawn, taking care of dirty dishes in the mess tent, or pawning off old knick-knacks at a yard sale. Anything to earn a buck or two, no task is too small for the savvy kids of Camp Kingdom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/f94461437f7dbfbc3c17c8669be812662bf9db54.gif[/img]

[h3]We will be talking more about the kids, the buildings, and what will make Kingdom Eighties a fresh new take on the series on our social media channels. Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/kingdomthegame]Twitter[/url]![/h3]

notes.title: Introducing (again) The Wiz & The Tinkerer
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome back, Campers!
[/h3]

We’ve already met The Leader and The Champ but there are two more friends that will provide specialized skills to help defeat the Greed. 

[b]The Wiz 💾[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/28e41cb7a24ec0614df472a2109ca2343c18c3bf.gif[/img]

The Wiz is the smartest kid on the block - and he knows it. When he’s not inventing new gadgets, he’s topping the leaderboards at the Polybius Arcade. Whether the scores are real or if he just hacked the machines, only he knows. While he’s easily frightened compared to his companions, once you find and return his remote controller, he’ll put his skills to good use building mechanical turrets and even assembling a siege robot. Along with the Champ's strength, this will be key to defeating the Greed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/a9460f2063aae573afc1972ddbbd0755d7615d81.gif[/img]

You’ll be surprised what he can make from just a few spare parts and circuit boards.


[b]The Tinkerer 🔧[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/5df2c318beee720a2c7fdb9fa7a196c35096873a.gif[/img]

As a member of the Junior Firefighter Brigade, all the training in the world could never have prepared The Tinkerer for the Summer of Greed. This resourceful optimist is pretty handy with a hammer and a wrench. If it’s broken, the Tinkerer can most likely fix it. You’ll find her at the firewatch tower but she’ll only join you when it’s safe to come down and you’ve proved yourself a worthy leader. Have you got what it takes to explore the foreboding forest and expand your territory beyond the shadows to win her favor?

Once on board, she’ll help in many ways; fixing things, upgrading your walls, and reinforcing the Wiz’s turrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/682616e30d458a865fc750b34d19b9bd5c5e009f.gif[/img]

Excited to see more about Kingdom Eighties? Why not follow us on Twitter, Facebook or chat in our Discord?

[h3]See you next time![/h3]

notes.title: Introducing (again) The Leader & The Champ
notes.content:
[h3]Since we’ve talked about Camp Kingdom and beyond, let’s talk in more detail about the characters you’ll meet along the way and their abilities. Re-introducing The Leader & The Champ.
[/h3]

[b]The Leader 👑

[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/f0c4a85e03b9acd44f90248849557a0043f771bf.gif[/img]

In Kingdom Eighties you play as The Leader, a young camp counsellor who has just discovered that strange creatures attack the camp at night. These attackers, which experienced Kingdom players will recognize as the Greed, demolish anything that stands in their way. But their main purpose seems to be something else... stealing The Leader's family legacy, the Crown of Creation.

The Leader will coordinate the neighborhood kids to build fortifications and gather resources. When the night comes, the Greed will attack without mercy. If you lose your crown, everything is doomed!

With no response from anyone at home, it’ll be up to The Leader to save not just the camp, but the entire town. Some of the older kids could provide specialized skills, but it will take some extra persuasion for them to join the effort. 

[b]The Champ 🏆
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/9b78c4cd0d6d26c4a8c658781b8935ce44a4f21e.gif[/img]

The Champ is one of the older kids at camp and one of The Leader's allies. Each will lend their special abilities to help the Leader complete a level and ultimately get one step closer to their goal. The Champ's strength, loyalty, and athleticism will come in handy when the time comes to fight back against the Greed. 

You’ll meet him hanging out by himself close to the camp, but you’ll need to find and return his trophy to him if you hope to lift his spirits and enlist his help. Once he’s feeling like a winner again, he’ll aid you by shielding your troops with a heavy dumpster especially when launching an all-out attack on a Greed portal. 

In our next post, we’ll learn more about The Tinkerer and The Wiz. For now, thanks for reading! Excited to see more about Kingdom Eighties? Why not follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/kingdomthegame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/kingdomthegame/]Facebook [/url]or chat in our [url=url=https://discord.gg/rawfury]Discord[/url]?

 
[i]See you next time![/i]

notes.title: Progress Blog #2 - April Update
notes.content:
Hey there, my name is Vladimir, and I'm part of the programming team here at Fury Studios, blogging at you [strike]live[/strike] asynchronously from beautiful Zagreb, Croatia. Today I'll share more about what we've been up to in the last couple of months. You've probably guessed that this post is going to get more technical, but fret not; all the techno-babble results in some wonderful upgrades to the look of Kingdom. But you won't have to trust me on that; I come bearing gifs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/10560dfabd813b39e93c3579d25ccfb33a54698b.gif[/img]
[i]Today is a gift, that's why they call it the Present![/i]

[h2][b]Today I'll focus on a new effect we added to Kingdom Eighties: Emission.[/b][/h2]

Emission is best described as a property of an object to glow independently, highlighting itself and objects around it. It's achieved by drawing pixels that should emit a glow into a separate texture and then adding that to our final image. Since it's all done dynamically, it allows us to play with the intensity, color, and spread of the glow to achieve the look we feel is perfect for Kingdom Eighties. Plus, it's fun to add to different objects in the game and see what a rad glow-in-the-dark deer would look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/f212c2719c83a8637ae688b53193242b1be9b666.gif[/img]
[i]Ghost Glow Intensity Example
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/578cdb01847d9fc180bebf14b2a17de783fcc602.gif[/img]
[i]Ghost Glow Color Example
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/2d681d7b9c82d5527d16ee573ade5183f2266ddd.gif[/img]
[i]Deer Glowing in the Forest
[/i]

[h3][b]So why add this to Kingdom? And why now?

Two reasons.[/b][/h3]

Kingdom has that "wow" factor in its presentation, and a lot of that comes down to the water and reflections, combined with the crisp pixel art. We knew we could expand our palette of visual effects and make it even more enjoyable to boot up a Kingdom game and just vibe out.

[b]Kingdom Eighties is special and stands apart from other Kingdom games and settings.[/b] While I know the 80s aren't exactly "modern times", our comparison points are the knights and vikings of Two Crowns, so I'll just go ahead and call this a Modern Setting. And so we've included a lot of sprites of modern architecture, some of which glow. Ferris wheels, shop signs, street lights... Plus, we also have a bit of a sci-fi twist, so it's not uncommon to see lasers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/031526faf55d66cffe7141cac260ea941a5d188d.gif[/img]
[i]Background buildings lit up in the night...
[/i]
[h3]I hope you enjoyed this quick peek into just one of the techniques we're applying to make this the richest Kingdom experience yet. We've been working mad hard on it, and we can't wait for you to get your bodacious hands on the game! [b]And, like, hella soon too![/b][/h3]

notes.content:
Welcome campers, 

We hosted a pretty cool Q&A over on the [url=https://discord.gg/rawfury]Raw Fury Discord[/url]. If you couldn’t make it then no need to stress, we bring you the highlights right here on your computer screen! 

This question-and-answer session was joined by: 
[list]
[*] Gordon (Game Director) 
[*] Elisabeth (Producer) 
[*] Vlado (Programmer) 
[*] Mariela (Brand Manager) 
[*] Fiona (Community Manager) 
[/list]
Ready? Set? Go! 🏁 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/f66344ed8c2f7156b5d7e3ede6b7e04f0a2493d2.gif[/img]

[b]Q:[/b] Will Kingdom Eighties have co-op? 
[b]Mariela —[/b] 
Kingdom Eighties will be a single-player game, with an exciting story behind 🙂 

[b]Q:[/b] How do i handle waiting for Kingdom Eighties? 
[b]Elisabeth — [/b]
Tease your hair, park yourself in the sofa of your parents house, re-watch your favourite 80s flicks and get immersed in the vibe! You really need to channel your inner teen from the US & A in the 80's even if you're a zoomer from Scandinavia. 
Like me. 🙂 

[b]Q:[/b] Is Kingdom Eighties gonna be a new game or just a dlc 
[b]Mariela — [/b]
Kingdom Eighties will be a single-player game, with an exciting story behind 🙂 

[b]Q:[/b] Will it have the same feel as other Kingdom games? (Same or similar gameplay) 
[list]
[*] Are we going to be building walls out of trash (Bicycles, bricks, trash cans, metal parts, car wreck) or reinforced wood, or anything? 
[*] Will there be same gameplay mechanic of exploring. 
[*] Where wil lit be set? Outside the town? On the outskirts? A path into the woods that needs to be blocked by teenagers? 
[/list]
[b]GordonVanDyke —[/b]  
Great question, short answer is yes, it will feel like a Kingdom game. 
[list]
[*] Yes, but it’s not always the route or path yet still familiar. 
[*] Yes, and more puzzles to figure things out. 
[*] You travel to four unique locations. 
[/list]
[b]Q:[/b] will 80’s be getting a switch port, and will a physical edition be available? 
[b]Fiona —  [/b]
Currently we're working towards a Steam release, making it the best experience possible. In the future we'll look at other platforms. 

[b]Q:[/b] will kingdom eighties be on mac 
[b]Fiona —  [/b]
Just Steam for now. 

[b]Q:[/b] Do you have plans on continuing development of Kingdom Eighties or will it basically be completely done after release? (after you fix all of those random bugs) 
[b]GordonVanDyke —[/b] 
Kingdom Eighties is a one off and won’t get new content in the same way as KTC. 

[b]Q:[/b] how is the kingdom eighties different from the usual series of the kingdom? 
[b]Elisabeth [RF] —  [/b]
Apart from the rad 80's setting, Kingdom Eighties is different in that it is a linear, narrative adventure. The game has a story and characters that you will get to know and collaborate with, and the levels will have their own identity and some unique challenges. The path we're taking with Eighties is something new that we wanted to try for the Kingdom series, and we're very excited to see what you think about it! 

[b]Q:[/b] Will Kingdom Eighties come to mobile platforms like the other versions? 
[b]Fiona —[/b]  
At this time we're working to release on Steam then will take a look at other platforms after. :) 

[b]Q:[/b] I've got a few questions regarding the balance of the game, firstly, is the balance finished/in a good place would you say? 
[b]GordonVanDyke — [/b] 
Yes and no, we have put in all the new gameplay features and now we’re interacting on them and making sure they’re fun. 

[b]Q:[/b] will there be new kinds of the greed? 
[b]GordonVanDyke — [/b]
Yes, we’ve teased them already. 😊 

[b]Q:[/b] Since the first location is based off of Muir Woods & Mt. Tamalpais in the Bay Area in California, is it safe to say that the setting in Kingdom Eighties takes place in the Bay Area, or California at least? 
[b]GordonVanDyke —[/b]  
Yup, that’s correct. 😎 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42371416/0d7a1fda6a0358624237a1850dabb0724d9bd753.gif[/img]
And that’s a wrap! We hope that some of your burning questions were answered. You can view the full Q&A in our [url=https://discord.gg/rawfury]Discord[/url] over in channel #kingdom-question-and-answers.  

Thank you so much to everyone to joined and we hope to do another in the near future, see you then!
